# LED Network

> > LED Network is a Canadian commercial lighting supplier specializing in LED fixtures, retrofit bulbs, controls, and light poles for outdoor and indoor applications.

LED Network offers a comprehensive catalog of commercial-grade LED lighting solutions including area lights, exterior fixtures, ceiling lights, and retrofit bulbs from manufacturers like Light Efficient Design. The company serves Canadian customers with shipping across the country and provides specialized products for construction, parking lots, and dark sky compliance.

## Key Topics

- Commercial LED Lighting
- LED Retrofit Bulbs
- Outdoor Lighting
- Solar Lights
- Fire-Rated Fixtures
- Dimmable Lights
- Motion-Sensor Lighting
- Light Efficient Design
- E26/E39 Base Bulbs
- Parking Lot Lights
- Post-Top Lights
- Dark Sky Compliant
- Exterior Lighting
- LED Controls
- Work Lights

## Outdoor & Area Lighting

- [Area Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/area-lights): Area lights collection including solar and motion-sensor outdoor lighting products
- [Flood Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/flood-lights): Flood lights collection with solar and motion-sensor outdoor LED fixtures
- [Exterior Lighting from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/exterior-lighting): Exterior lighting collection with solar LED fixtures and motion-sensor options
- [Building Exterior Lighting from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/building-exterior-lighting): Building exterior lighting collection with solar and retrofit LED fixture options
- [Dark Sky Lighting from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/dark-sky-lighting): Dark sky lighting with adjustable CCT and dimmable outdoor LED fixtures
- [Barn Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/barn-lights): Barn lights collection with weather-resistant LED yard and farm lighting solutions

## Interior & Specialized Lighting

- [Ceiling Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/ceiling-lights): Ceiling lights including fire-rated pot lights and dimmable LED panel fixtures
- [Fire Rated Pot Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/fire-rated-pot-lights): Fire-rated LED pot lights with dimmable and color-temperature selectable options
- [Drop Ceiling Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/drop-ceiling-lights): Drop ceiling lights with fire-rated LED pot and panel light options
- [LED Garage Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/led-garage-lights): Commercial-grade LED garage and work lights from Light Efficient Design
- [Construction Lights from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/construction-lights): Construction lights collection with LED work lights and temporary lighting equipment

## LED Retrofit Bulbs

- [E26 Base Bulbs from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/e26-base-bulbs): E26 base LED retrofit bulbs for bollard and wall pack fixtures
- [E39 Base Bulbs from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/e39-base-bulbs): E39 base LED retrofit lamps for wall pack and shoe-box outdoor lighting
- [Exterior Light Bulbs from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/exterior-light-bulbs): Exterior LED bulbs for retrofit applications including bollard and post-top lights
- [Enclosed Fixture Bulbs from LEDNetwork](https://lednetwork.ca/collections/enclosed-fixture-bulbs): Enclosed fixture LED retrofit bulbs for bollard, wall pack, and shoe-box lights
